title: Island Garden — App-Style PoC
description: The twenty-theme learning garden as floating island dioramas in an app shell: full-screen painted canvas by default with the interface floating over it - Little Grains-style header, learning-context panel on desktop, bottom navigation on mobile, ten-state growth slider, demo lesson stops rooted in the scenery, and viewport-shape-aware artwork that swaps compositions on rotation or resize (distinct portrait and wide compositions in progress).
